phrases.swahili: Amani ya ndani, utajiri wa kweli.

phrases.english: What do you think of this?
What is your path to peace?
phrases.swahili: Njia yako ya amani ni ipi?
Matumaini yako ya amani ni yapi?

phrases.english: What's your best advice for calm?
phrases.swahili: Ushauri wako bora wa utulivu ni upi?

phrases.english: Are we on the same page?

phrases.swahili: Hatua inayofuata ya amani ni ipi?

phrases.english: What do you recommend for peace?
Go with the current, don't fight it.
A calm heart, a good life.
Patience is a key, unlock peace.
Listen to the wind, it whispers wisdom.
The quiet mind, sees everything clearly.
phrases.swahili: Akilini kimya, huona kila kitu wazi.

phrases.english: Today is a gift, accept it gladly.
phrases.swahili: Leo ni zawadi, ipokee kwa furaha.
Hewa ya kina, amani ya kina.
Nguvu ya kweli, ni utulivu wa ndani.

phrases.english: Let go of yesterday, embrace today.
Find the sun, even on cloudy days.
phrases.swahili: Tafuta jua, hata siku za mawingu.

phrases.english: The seed of peace, is within.
A quiet mind, is a happy mind.
phrases.swahili: Akilini tulivu, ni akili yenye furaha.

phrases.english: Inner peace, is the real wealth.
phrases.swahili: Amani ya ndani, ndiyo utajiri halisi.

phrases.english: Peace is a choice, make it.
Let go, of what is gone.

phrases.swahili: Ulimwengu wangu wa ndani, ni mkali.

phrases.english: Daily, positive affirmations, help a lot.
phrases.swahili: Kukiri vitu vizuri kila siku, kunasaidia sana.

phrases.english: What helps you, relax after work?
phrases.swahili: Nini hukusaidia, kupumzika baada ya kazi?

phrases.english: This makes me smile, a lot!

phrases.swahili: Hii inafanya kila kitu kuwa bora!, wow!

phrases.english: A moment of pure joy!, indeed!
phrases.swahili: Muda wa furaha tupu!, kweli kabisa!
Siri yako ni nini, ya furaha?

phrases.english: How did you get, so cheerful?
Do you think, life is fair?
Tell me more, about your day.
What's your dream, for the future?
phrases.swahili: Ndoto yako ni ipi, kwa baadaye?

phrases.english: How do you relax, after work?
What do you enjoy, doing most?
Are you content, with your life?
What makes a good, day for you?
phrases.swahili: Nini hufanya siku, kuwa nzuri kwako?

phrases.english: What's the best, way to learn?
phrases.swahili: Njia bora ya kujifunza, ni ipi?

phrases.english: How can I improve, my Swahili?
What's your opinion, on this matter?
phrases.swahili: Maoni yako ni yapi, kuhusu jambo hili?

phrases.english: What are your, plans for tonight?
phrases.swahili: Mipango yako ni ipi, kwa leo usiku?

phrases.english: Is there anything, else I can do?
You are stronger, than you think.
Never give up, on your dreams.
Small steps, lead to big wins.
Let go, of what you cannot control.
Every day, is a new chance.
You have the power, within you.
Good things, come to those who wait.
You are capable, of great things.
You are enough, just as you are.
Believe in the good, around you.

phrases.swahili: Nguvu yangu, ya ndani iko hapa.

phrases.english: Take a deep breath, then exhale slowly.
phrases.swahili: Vuta pumzi ndefu, kisha toa taratibu.

phrases.english: Do one small kind act, today.
Listen to your favorite music, now.
Disconnect from screens, for a while.
Share a smile, with a stranger.
Find a quiet spot, to reflect.
Drink enough water, throughout the day.
phrases.swahili: Kunywa maji ya kutosha, mchana kutwa.

phrases.english: You can do it, believe yourself.
Keep pushing, the end is near.
Keep your eyes on the prize.
What if I feel like quitting?
How do you handle big challenges?
What's your advice for tough times?
How do you bounce back from failure?
Is it okay to ask for help?
What keeps you going when tired?
Do you believe in second chances?
How do you celebrate small wins?
What if progress is very slow?
phrases.swahili: Vipi ikiwa maendeleo ni polepole sana?

phrases.english: Can we work on this together?
What's the hardest part for you?
phrases.swahili: Ni sehemu gani ngumu zaidi kwako?

phrases.english: Do you think I can do this?
How do you learn from mistakes?
Are you willing to try again?
What does perseverance mean to you?
How do you avoid giving up?
What if I fail one more time?
How do you find your inner strength?
Do you believe in progress, not perfection?
What's your strategy for overcoming obstacles?
phrases.swahili: Ni mkakati wako wa kushinda vikwazo?

phrases.english: How do you regain focus after a setback?
phrases.swahili: Unarejesha vipi umakini baada ya kurudi nyuma?

phrases.english: Is it important to celebrate milestones?
Believe in your ability, keep pushing.
Your effort matters, don't stop now.
phrases.swahili: Juhudi zako ni muhimu, usikome sasa.

phrases.english: This challenge is temporary, you are strong.
phrases.swahili: Changamoto hii ni ya muda mfupi, wewe ni hodari.

phrases.english: Focus on the next step, then another.
Small progress is still progress, well done!
phrases.swahili: Maendeleo madogo bado ni maendeleo, kazi nzuri!

phrases.english: Embrace the learning process, it shapes you.
Every effort builds towards your goal.
phrases.swahili: Kila jitihada hujenga kuelekea lengo lako.

phrases.english: Don't underestimate your resilience, you've got this.
Keep your mindset positive, see solutions.
phrases.swahili: Weka akili yako chanya, ona suluhisho.

phrases.english: You're stronger than you think, keep going.
phrases.swahili: Wewe ni hodari kuliko unavyofikiria, endelea.

phrases.english: This journey takes time, be patient.
phrases.swahili: Safari hii inahitaji muda, kuwa mvumilivu.

phrases.english: Celebrate small victories along the way.

phrases.swahili: Uamuzi wako ni wa kushangaza, kweli.

phrases.english: Let challenges fuel your fire, not fear.
phrases.swahili: Ruhusu changamoto ziwe kichocheo chako, si hofu.

phrases.english: You are building resilience with every step.
Keep your eyes forward, learn from the past.
phrases.swahili: Weka macho yako mbele, jifunze kutoka nyuma.

phrases.english: It's okay to rest, but don't give up.
phrases.swahili: Ni sawa kupumzika, lakini usikate tamaa.

phrases.english: Your potential is immense, keep exploring.
phrases.swahili: Uwezo wako ni mkubwa sana, endelea kuchunguza.

phrases.english: Trust the process, it will unfold.
Inner strength is your greatest asset.
phrases.swahili: Nguvu ya ndani ni mali yako kuu.

phrases.english: This effort builds character, well done.
phrases.swahili: Juhudi hizi zinajenga tabia, kazi nzuri.
Ona vikwazo kama mawe ya kupandia.

phrases.english: Keep moving forward, step by step.
phrases.swahili: Endelea kusonga mbele, hatua kwa hatua.

phrases.english: Never underestimate the power of trying.
Keep your vision clear, stay focused.
phrases.swahili: Weka maono yako wazi, kaa makini.

phrases.english: My heart feels heavy, but I must continue.
phrases.swahili: Moyo wangu mzito, lakini lazima niendelee.

phrases.english: Sometimes, I just need a moment to breathe.
Giving up is not my option.
This feeling of doubt, it will pass.
I reflect on how far I have come.
My patience is being tested, truly.
A deep sigh, then back to work.
Can I admit I'm tired, and still go?
phrases.swahili: Naweza kukiri nimechoka, na bado kuendelea?

phrases.english: This internal struggle, it makes me stronger.
phrases.swahili: Pambano hili la ndani, linanipa nguvu.

phrases.english: I feel a quiet resolve building inside.
My spirit feels weary, but not broken.
phrases.swahili: Roho yangu imeanza kuchoka, lakini haijavunjika.

phrases.english: Holding onto hope, even when it's dim.
phrases.swahili: Nashikilia matumaini, hata ikiwa ni hafifu.

phrases.english: This thought keeps me going: 'Just one more try'.
phrases.swahili: Wazo hili hunifanya niendelee: 'Jitahidi mara moja zaidi'.

phrases.english: A little bit of self-compassion goes far.
phrases.swahili: Huruma kidogo kwangu huenda mbali sana.

phrases.english: My mind races, but my feet stay put.
phrases.swahili: Akili yangu inakimbia, lakini miguu yangu imetulia.

phrases.english: Is it okay to feel overwhelmed sometimes?
phrases.swahili: Je, inafaa kuhisi kuzidiwa wakati mwingine?

phrases.english: I choose to believe in the long game.
This quiet determination is my strength.
phrases.swahili: Uamuzi huu wa utulivu ni nguvu yangu.

phrases.english: Learning to accept the slow pace.
A moment of doubt, followed by resolve.
phrases.swahili: Wakati wa shaka, ukifuatiwa na azimio.

phrases.english: I'm planting seeds, waiting for growth.
My emotions are valid, my effort too.
phrases.swahili: Hisia zangu ni halali, juhudi zangu pia.

phrases.english: Can I be gentle with myself right now?
phrases.swahili: Naweza kuwa mpole na mimi mwenyewe sasa hivi?

phrases.english: Finding peace in the effort, not just the win.
phrases.swahili: Kupata amani katika jitihada, sio ushindi tu.

phrases.english: This journey requires a patient heart.
phrases.swahili: Safari hii inahitaji moyo wenye subira.

phrases.english: I trust the unfolding of this process.
phrases.swahili: Ninaamini katika kuendelea kwa mchakato huu.

phrases.english: My spirit is willing, even if my body aches.
phrases.swahili: Roho yangu inataka, hata mwili ukiuuma.

phrases.english: Allowing myself to feel, then move on.
What if this struggle is part of the plan?
phrases.swahili: Je, ikiwa shida hii ni sehemu ya mpango?

phrases.english: One day at a time, friend.
Keep trying, it's not over yet.

phrases.swahili: Changamoto hii ni ya muda, kumbuka.

phrases.english: Not really, I don't think so.

phrases.swahili: Hiyo inaweza kujadiliwa, kwa maoni yangu.

phrases.english: No way, that can't be right.
You might be right about that.
I'm with you on that one.
Fair enough, I can accept that.
That's a good point, I hadn't considered.
That's one way to look at it.
phrases.swahili: Hiyo ni njia moja ya kuangalia.

phrases.english: I'm on the fence about that.
That's exactly what I was thinking.
I'm not so sure about that.
I disagree, with all due respect.
That's a stretch, in my view.
phrases.swahili: Hiyo ni kunyoosha, kwa maoni yangu.

phrases.english: So, what do you think, friend?
Does that sound good to you?
Is that the way it works?
Do you agree with that plan?
How do you feel about this?
What if we did it differently?
What do you advise me to do?
Is there a better way, perhaps?
Do you see any problems here?

phrases.swahili: Hukumu yako ni ipi juu ya hilo?

phrases.english: Does that make sense to you?

phrases.swahili: Wazo lako la kwanza ni lipi?

phrases.english: How would you handle this situation?

phrases.swahili: Mtazamo wako juu yake ni upi?

phrases.english: Do you have any other ideas?

phrases.swahili: Uamuzi wako wa mwisho ni upi?

phrases.english: That's a brilliant idea, love it!
phrases.swahili: Hiyo ni fikra nzuri sana, nimeipenda!

phrases.english: I believe in you, you got this!

phrases.swahili: Ndio, hiyo ndiyo tabia ya ushindi!

phrases.english: Spot on, your focus is amazing!
Couldn't have said it better, wow!
You got it, that's the way!

phrases.swahili: Bila shaka, juhudi zako ni kubwa!
Niko na wewe, fikra nzuri sana!

phrases.english: Good point, keep up the good work!
phrases.swahili: Hoja nzuri, endelea na kazi nzuri!

phrases.english: Indeed, you're a star, keep shining!
phrases.swahili: Hakika, wewe ni nyota, endelea kung'aa!

phrases.english: I agree, great potential you have!
You said it, that's the mindset!
Absolutely, you're on the right track!
phrases.swahili: Bila shaka, uko kwenye njia sahihi!

phrases.english: I sense the truth in it.
My gut tells me the same.
I feel a sense of peace.
My heart tells me to agree.
You've hit the nail on the head.
